folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B286: proposal closeout and source-wave limits
folds.body:
The full [proposal review](PROPOSAL_REVIEW.md), including its final Q1 correction, qualifies the original completion/ranking text above. All 13 packet IDs remain recoverable, but they were not all new missing systems. Q1 explicitly closes five duplicates (M-P1/M-P3/M-P4/S-O1/S-O3) plus the separate A-P4 scope drop. The opening F1 phrase calling six proposals duplicates is qualified by that correction. D1, S-O2 alloy plus M-P2 equipped technique output/fuel, was subsequently sent to a builder. That selection is narrower than the ranking or all five Achra ideas, and this review supplies no D1 delivery proof. Preserve the remaining variants as dated later possibilities, not a new queue.

The old one-realm/one-prestige milestone and mandatory playtest-before-new-wave premise no longer determine current sequencing; use current [project focus](../../../../PROJECT.md#current-focus) and domain authority. The review distinguishes source-read V from grep/inferred I, not live-browser verification. It already names an opt-in saved duel/party contest, so A-P1's later wording about waiting for a real opt-in combat surface cannot establish blanket absence. General real-time native combat and the narrow saved encounter still have different support. A-P2's saved-field migration concern remains local to its actual selected version; the historical schema number is not a new schema assignment.

Keep the useful combined consumer: actually smelt a supported alloy, make an item, equip it, observe one declared technique/fuel effect, then remove it with coherent persistence. A new recipe name or stat fact alone does not deliver that loop. S-O4's proposed cycle valuation is a local economy policy, not a global anti-arbitrage law; source-supported creation or profit can work with an actual mechanism. The game must not accidentally publish the same transfer twice, which is a separate save-integrity issue.

This wave's public source evidence remains bounded: old Achra v0.4.7 recovery is not a reconstructed build or current retail; Magic source-map availability/extraction is not full-body reading; Soulash demo JSON links do not prove native enforcement or later retail devlog semantics. Erenshor/Matchless source absence, Factorio live-worker status and download routes were statements at that checkpoint, not checked current conditions or permission to acquire anything. No game dossier, executable, private source, storefront or browser is newly reviewed here, and no historical audit worker or content wave is relaunched.
